description: Zoo Merge invites you into a vibrant animal world where combining creatures leads to wild surprises. Match identical animals to evolve them into new, adorable species – from tiny critters to majestic beasts. As your zoo grows, so does the challenge! Can you discover all the animals and build the ultimate merge-zoo paradise? With cozy visuals, catchy sounds, and a one-more-try feeling, this charming puzzle game is perfect for players of all ages who love animals and relaxing fun.
name: Zoo Merge
